root_validation: Recompute canonical state_root_hash excluding only itself
Verify all 30 input byte hashes and Git blob IDs at BASE
Verify protocol/schema refs at publication HEAD
Compare all 192 prior blob IDs unchanged
Do not convert raw/legacy state into claims/events automatically
record_hash_rule: Use control/workflow_protocol_v3.json#/serialization/canonical_contract for every semantic record/dataset/root hash, excluding only its declared self-hash field. Exact stored-byte SHA256 remains separate.
engineering_value_rules: Units and precision fields always present; UNKNOWN units/precision explicitly represented; never guessed from context.
Decimal strings preserve significant source detail; precision metadata records rounding/measurement limits.
CONFLICT has null selected value and parallel claims; no canonical value silently chosen.
OPEN/UNKNOWN/NOT_APPLICABLE have null value; QUARANTINED is explicit and cannot be consumed as accepted fact.
Validate interval ordering, dimensional compatibility, unit vocabulary and uncertainty method semantically before acceptance.

claim_kind_rules.SOURCE_ASSERTION: Explicit source statement, not confirmed physical truth.
claim_kind_rules.ENGINEERING_DERIVATION: Reproducible calculation with inputs, units and method.
claim_kind_rules.ENGINEERED_RECONSTRUCTION: Explicit modeled reconstruction, never verbatim historical evidence.
claim_kind_rules.OBSERVATION: Recorded observation with provenance and limits.
claim_kind_rules.CONFLICT: Preserved incompatible evidence/claims, no forced resolution.

canonical_implementation: Delivery support file mre3_canonical.py is a reference implementation, not an additional repository path. Contract authority is the hash-bound workflow policy.
